Lemma
[Bounds for vector fields of shrinking Ricci solitons] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0187 1. ch30:30.37\group Nongradient Shrinkers

Let $(\mathcal M^n,g,X,-1)$ be a complete noncompact shrinking Ricci soliton structure with bounded Ricci curvature, so that \[ 2R_{ij}+ abla _iX_j+ abla _jX_i-g_{ij}=0. \] For $r(x)=d_g(x,O)$, there is $C<\infty $ such that \[ \langle X, abla r angle (x)\geq rac{r(x)}2-C \] away from $O$.
